scope: Private owner-side fence for immutable async region reads; no live game wiring or placement authorization

cases: Same world with new root publication epoch rejects (root ABA fence).
Clearing a populated affected chunk rejects.
Cancelled, exceptional, wrong-count and wrong-position results reject.
Real disk result is exact, remains usable after unrelated edit, and becomes stale after affected edit.
Stale/failed views never revive; storage-thread cleanup removes owned decoded cache.
tests.initial_test_note: Initial clear fixture had no affected override to clear, so its chunk stamp correctly stayed unchanged. The final fixture populates that chunk before capture and verifies real removal; root-epoch obligations remain unchanged.

playtest.entry: Playtest: actual CLI and its own Swing result window completed with exit 0; screenshot captured on inherited assigned display/authentication and inspected.
steps: Capture owner/world/root/model/chunk fences around a pending read.
Complete the read and change each guarded state; verify stale/failed results never become ready again.
Open and read the real disk index/cache on its storage worker; verify exact cell, unrelated-edit validity, affected-edit rejection and cleanup.
playtest.expected: Pending remains distinct from absence; completed results revalidate; stale/failed reads cannot provide current ready data.
playtest.browser: Not applicable to CLI-only change. Production/native harness unchanged; all 228 source hashes still match completed native workflow.

limits: Capture/poll require the same owner and its world mutation lock.
Caller must replace the root epoch on every root publication, including ABA.
Ready is immutable read data, not placement authorization. Retained ready results require current owner/authority checks again before mutation.
The index/cache is the trusted validated immutable data source; this fence is not package or dependency validation.
Views retain their captured references; caller must bound live views and release stale data. No total memory or owner timing qualification claimed.
No live game wiring, save/renderer/physics/server integration, full city/maximum admission or required 20-run qualification completed.
Physical GPU, shaped 32-client and all remaining frame/tick/traffic/memory/stall/durability budgets stay pending; stable rollout gated.
publication: New tooling/tests/docs/media pending controller publication and exact-source hosted checks
